units: native reporting currency, millions (see per-company ccy; EPS per share, margins %)
note: Quarterly = direct BBG kFQ consensus. CY = calendar-year sum on a uniform non-GAAP basis: forecast quarters use kFQ consensus, and reported quarters use the BBG comparable/adjusted actual via a past fiscal-period override (NOT the GAAP bdh actual, which would mix bases and understate adjusted EPS/NI); fiscal quarters snapped to nearest calendar quarter. Street-high: _HI fields (capex _LO=high spend), outlier-guarded; CY street-high = sum of quarterly highs. CY ocf = BEST_ESTIMATE_FCF + |BEST_CAPEX| on BBG's <yr>BC calendar blend (fcf_bc/capex_bc; no BEst OCF field; ocf_flag = OCF < 0 while EBITDA > 0 and |OCF| <= 25% of capex, i.e. a sign the FCF/capex analyst-set mismatch can flip -> unreliable). `actual` = latest reported FY OCF/capex/FCF. ccy = fundamentals currency (ADRs report native: TM ¥, TSM NT$, ASML/IFX €). 1FY/2FY/3FY = BBG annual consensus lines via BEST_FPERIOD_OVERRIDE — a DIFFERENT period from the CY sums whenever the fiscal year is not the calendar year; use the annual line for any fiscal-year claim and never net the two. pt = consensus target price/high/low/rating/rec counts (per LISTING: dual-listed names poll different panels).
